description: This file defines an Android activity named PlayerActivity which provides a local video player interface using VideoView. It handles video playback, progress updates, and user interactions like play/pause and seeking.

classes.name: PlayerActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity for playing a local video using VideoView, with controls for play/pause and seeking, and updating progress periodically.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, prepares the video URI, and configures event listeners for buttons and SeekBar.

methods.name: scheduleProgressUpdates
methods.description: Schedules periodic updates to refresh SeekBar progress based on current video playback position.
